# SFX kit licences (vendor/sfx/, inlined as vendor/sfx-kit.js)

All seven one-shots are **CC0 1.0** (public domain dedication, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): use, modify and redistribute, including monetised video. Attribution is optional; credit is given below.

Copied from Bart's `motion-graphics` repo (`skills/sound-effects/sfx/kit/*` and `sfx/ding/kenney-interface-confirmation-001.ogg`); rows below are copied from that repo's `LICENSES.md` and `sfx/manifest.json`. The sound-pass approach is credited to **Vox (@Voxyz_ai)**. Freesound sounds were verified CC0 per sound page on 2026-10-12; the Kenney pack licence (License.txt) states CC0. If a source page ever changes its terms, the sha256 below pins the exact bytes shipped.

Not vendored: the Mixkit `typing` sample (Mixkit licence forbids standalone redistribution).
